name: CnT-processing
description: CUT&Tag processing: paired-end FASTQ to normalized bigWigs, featureCounts, SEACR peaks, QC and a MultiQC report

samplesheet.help: Sample sheet CSV with the columns sample,fastq_1,fastq_2,control,is_control,pool (see the README)

readcount_scaled_bw.help: Also write read-count scaled bigWigs (only meaningful if every library in a pool started from the same number of cells and was pooled by equal volume)

blacklist_filter.help: Remove fragments that overlap the ENCODE blacklist before every downstream step

dedup_controls.help: Use deduplicated IgG control fragments for SEACR (suggested by the Henikoff lab tutorial, because IgG duplication is high)

min_mapq.help: Minimum MAPQ of a kept read

optical_pixel_distance.help: Picard OPTICAL_DUPLICATE_PIXEL_DISTANCE: 2500 for patterned flow cells (NovaSeq, HiSeq X/4000), 100 for unpatterned flow cells

promoter_window.help: Promoters = protein-coding TSS +/- this many bp (featureCounts)

plot_window.help: +/- bp around TSSs and peak summits in the deepTools plots

keep_chrM.help: Keep the mitochondrial chromosome in the fragments, bigWigs and genome_size

bowtie2_index.help: Optional. Bowtie2 index prefix. Leave empty to use the shared Fred Hutch index for the genome
